nodes.description: Biallelic missense, start-codon or other loss-of-function variants in MPC1 or MPC2 are the initiating lesion. Because the two subunits stabilise each other, variants in either gene can destabilise the whole complex; patient fibroblasts with MPC1 variants show reduced MPC1 and MPC2 protein.

nodes.description: Pyruvate cannot cross the inner mitochondrial membrane, so it is not oxidised by pyruvate dehydrogenase even though that enzyme and the respiratory chain are intact. Patient fibroblasts show reduced pyruvate-driven respiration that is restored by re-expressing the wild-type subunit, and a profile that mimics control cells treated with the carrier inhibitor alpha-cyano-4-hydroxycinnamate.

nodes.description: MPC1 and MPC2 form a hetero-oligomeric complex of about 150 kDa in the inner mitochondrial membrane, and each subunit is needed to stabilise the other. Pathogenic variants leave either no stable complex or a complex that cannot transport pyruvate.

nodes.description: Complete Mpc1 loss is embryonic-lethal at about E13.5, with lactic acidosis, depleted TCA cycle intermediates, energy deficit and abnormal brain morphology and neurotransmitter balance. A maternal ketogenic diet reverses these changes and allows normal gestation, although pups die shortly after birth.
Viable mice with partial MPC1 loss have low body weight and reduced movement that improve on a high-fat diet, consistent with fatty acid oxidation compensating for reduced pyruvate oxidation.

Reduced oxidation of glucose-derived pyruvate deprives the developing brain of energy, producing developmental delay, microcephaly, hypotonia, seizures and, in severe cases, encephalopathy and early death.

nodes.description: Pyruvate-derived acetyl-CoA no longer feeds the tricarboxylic acid cycle, so oxidative energy production from glucose falls. Tissues most dependent on glucose oxidation, above all the developing brain, are most affected. Glutamine and beta-hydroxybutyrate can still sustain respiration in carrier-deficient cells because they enter the cycle by other routes.
